extra_vocab.en: a letter from a person who knows you and says good things about your work
extra_vocab.note: 此處照原樣保留拼法，正確拼法是 reference letter。多益常見於求職或申請時，請前主管或老師寫信證明你的工作能力與品格。
extra_vocab.pattern: write / ask for + a reference letter + for / from + 人
extra_vocab.grammar_note: reference letter 是可數名詞，要寫 a reference letter 或 reference letters；說「幫誰寫」用 for，說「由誰寫」用 from。

examples.en: Please attach a reference letter from your former manager.
examples.zh: 請附上前主管寫的推薦信。

examples.en: Could you write a reference letter for me this week?
examples.zh: 你這週可以幫我寫一封推薦信嗎？

examples.en: I brought two reference letters to the interview today.
examples.zh: 我今天帶了兩封推薦信來面試。

examples.en: The company requires a reference letter before the final offer.
examples.zh: 公司在發出最終錄取通知前，需要一封推薦信。

similar.diff: 意思幾乎相同，美式更常說，語氣稍微強調「推薦」。

example.en: He asked his professor for a recommendation letter.
example.zh: 他向教授要了一封推薦信。

similar.diff: 同樣是推薦信，說法較正式，常見於書面文件。

example.en: She included a letter of reference with her application.
example.zh: 她在申請資料中附上了一封推薦信。

confusable.diff: cover letter 是求職者自己寫的求職信，reference letter 是別人寫來推薦你的信。

example.en: Your cover letter should explain why you want this job.
example.zh: 你的求職信應該說明你為什麼想要這份工作。

extra_vocab.en: a person who has an important management job in a company
extra_vocab.note: 此處照原樣保留拼法，正確拼法是 executive。多益常見於 chief executive、sales executive 與 executive meeting，指公司的高階主管，或形容「主管級的」。

example.en: Several executives will attend the board meeting on Monday morning.
example.zh: 幾位主管會出席星期一早上的董事會。

example.en: The chief executive announced a new plan to the staff.
example.zh: 執行長向員工宣布了一項新計畫。

example.en: Every senior executive must approve the budget before it is sent.
example.zh: 每位資深主管都必須在預算送出前核准。

collocations.zh: 摘要（報告開頭的重點整理）

example.en: Please read the executive summary before the meeting starts.
example.zh: 請在會議開始前先讀這份摘要。

examples.en: The executive team meets every Monday to review sales results.
examples.zh: 主管團隊每週一開會檢討銷售成績。

examples.en: Please forward this report to the executive in charge of marketing.
examples.zh: 請把這份報告轉寄給負責行銷的主管。

examples.en: She works as an account executive at an advertising firm.
examples.zh: 她在一家廣告公司擔任客戶業務專員。

examples.en: He booked an executive room at the hotel for the trip.
examples.zh: 他為這趟出差在飯店訂了一間行政客房。

confusable.diff: execute 是動詞，意思是「執行」；executive 是名詞（主管）或形容詞（主管級的）。
confusable.usage: execute 是動詞，後面接計畫、命令等受詞；executive 指人或用來修飾名詞。

example.en: The team will execute the plan next month.
example.zh: 團隊下個月會執行這項計畫。

example.en: The manager approved our travel request this morning.
example.zh: 經理今天早上核准了我們的出差申請。

example.en: The director will speak at the annual meeting.
example.zh: 董事將在年度會議上發言。

derived.link: 詞幹 execute，意思是把計畫真的做出來，是這一族的基礎動詞
execute + -ion，把「執行」這個動作變成名詞，像 decide → decision

example.en: The company hired a new executive to lead the sales team.
example.zh: 公司聘請了一位新主管來帶領業務團隊。

example.en: The executive committee will vote on the new budget.
example.zh: 執行委員會將針對新預算進行表決。

senses.en: a senior person who makes big decisions in a company

example.en: The executives agreed to open a new office in Tokyo.
example.zh: 主管們同意在東京開設新辦公室。

senses.en: a person with a certain job in a company, like sales or marketing
senses.distinguish: 前面通常有 sales、account 等字，表示負責某類工作的職員，不一定是高階主管。

example.en: Our sales executive visited three clients in Taipei this week.
example.zh: 我們的業務專員這週拜訪了三位台北的客戶。

extra_vocab.en: more than enough; existing in large amounts
extra_vocab.note: 多用在 supply、food、resources 等名詞前，或用 be plentiful 描述資源、工作機會很多；比 enough 更強調「很多」。

example.en: Fresh fruit is more plentiful in summer than in winter.
example.zh: 新鮮水果在夏天比冬天更充足。

example.en: Rice is the most plentiful crop in this region.
example.zh: 稻米是這個地區最豐富的作物。

example.en: The store keeps a plentiful supply of printer paper.
example.zh: 這家店備有充足的影印紙。

example.en: The new factory has plentiful resources for large orders.
example.zh: 新工廠有足夠的資源處理大量訂單。

example.en: Job openings are plentiful in the technology industry now.
example.zh: 科技業目前的職缺很多。

examples.en: Raw materials are plentiful this year, so prices have dropped.
examples.zh: 今年原料充足，所以價格下降了。

examples.en: Parking spaces are plentiful near our office building.
examples.zh: 我們辦公大樓附近的停車位很多。

examples.en: We are happy to report that stock is plentiful this season.
examples.zh: 我們很高興告知，本季庫存充足。

confusable.diff: plenty 是名詞或代名詞，表示「大量」；plentiful 是形容詞，表示「很充足的」。
confusable.usage: plenty 常用 plenty of + 名詞；plentiful 直接修飾名詞或接在 be 動詞後面，不加 of。

example.en: We have plenty of time to finish the report.
example.zh: 我們有很多時間完成這份報告。

similar.diff: 語氣較正式，常用來形容自然資源或大量的供給。

example.en: The region has abundant water and rich farmland.
example.zh: 這個地區有充沛的水源和肥沃的農地。

similar.diff: 表示「足夠」而已，不一定很多；plentiful 強調數量很多。

example.en: We have sufficient funds to start the project.
example.zh: 我們有足夠的資金啟動這個專案。

example.en: There is ample space for all the new desks.
example.zh: 有充裕的空間放所有新桌子。

example.en: Skilled workers are scarce in this small town.
example.zh: 這個小鎮上技術工人很少。

derived.link: 詞幹 plent-，plenty 是名詞，表示「很多」，是這一族的基礎字
plentiful + -ly，形容詞變副詞，像 quick → quickly

extra_vocab.en: a person who learns a job by working with a skilled worker
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於製造、建築、餐飲等需要學技術的工作，指跟著師傅邊做邊學、通常有固定期間的人；常搭配 apprentice program。

example.en: The factory hired six apprentices to learn machine repair.
example.zh: 工廠雇用了六名學徒來學機器維修。

example.en: Our apprentice program lasts for two years.
example.zh: 我們的學徒計畫為期兩年。

example.en: He worked as an apprentice at a local car shop.
example.zh: 他曾在當地一家汽車修理店當學徒。

example.en: Ms. Lin will train the new apprentice next week.
example.zh: 林小姐下週會訓練新來的學徒。

examples.en: We are looking for an apprentice to join our kitchen team.
examples.zh: 我們正在找一位學徒加入廚房團隊。

examples.en: He applied to be an apprentice at a design studio.
examples.zh: 他申請到一家設計工作室當學徒。

examples.en: Your apprentice will start work on the first of March.
examples.zh: 您的學徒將在三月一日開始工作。

confusable.diff: intern 多半是學生，做短期實習；apprentice 是長期跟著師傅學技術的人。

example.en: The summer intern helped us organize customer files.
example.zh: 暑期實習生幫我們整理了客戶檔案。

example.en: Each trainee gets a guide for the first week.
example.zh: 每位受訓人員第一週都會拿到一本指南。

example.en: My assistant will send you the schedule today.
example.zh: 我的助理今天會把時程表寄給你。

derived.link: apprentice + -ship，表示身分或時期，像 friendship、leadership

extra_vocab.en: to explain something clearly, or to arrange things in a plan
extra_vocab.note: 多益最常見的是「有條理地說明、列出（計畫、條款）」，如 lay out a plan；也可指擺放物品或設計版面。
extra_vocab.pattern: lay out + N（計畫／條款／文件）
extra_vocab.grammar_note: lay out 可以分開用，名詞放中間：lay the plan out；代名詞一定放中間：lay it out。lay 的三態是 lay–laid–laid，不要和 lie 搞混。

examples.en: The manager will lay out the budget plan at the meeting.
examples.zh: 經理會在會議上詳細說明預算計畫。

examples.en: Our email lays out the rules for using the new system.
examples.zh: 我們的郵件說明了使用新系統的規則。

examples.en: Designers laid out the product photos on the first page.
examples.zh: 設計師把產品照片排在第一頁。

examples.en: Please lay out the documents on the table before the guests arrive.
examples.zh: 請在客人抵達前把文件擺在桌上。

examples.en: The contract lays out each person's duties clearly.
examples.zh: 合約清楚列出每個人的職責。

similar.diff: 意思較一般；lay out 強調有條理地把整個計畫或內容一項一項列出來。

example.en: Can you explain the new schedule to the team?
example.zh: 你可以向團隊說明新的時程嗎？

similar.diff: 意思接近，語氣稍微正式，常用於報告或文件。

example.en: The report sets out three ways to cut costs.
example.zh: 這份報告列出了三種降低成本的方法。

confusable.diff: lay off 是「資遣員工」，和 lay out 意思完全不同。

example.en: The company had to lay off ten workers last month.
example.zh: 公司上個月不得不資遣十名員工。

extra_vocab.en: an increase in the money you earn from your job
extra_vocab.note: 美式常說 pay raise，英式多說 pay rise；多益常見於績效評估、薪資協商與公司公告。
extra_vocab.pattern: get / give + 人 + a pay raise
extra_vocab.grammar_note: pay raise 是可數名詞，要寫 a pay raise；要求加薪說 ask for a pay raise，不說 ask a pay raise。

examples.en: I would like to ask about the chance of a pay raise.
examples.zh: 我想請問有沒有加薪的機會。

examples.en: Good sales results helped her earn a pay raise this year.
examples.zh: 良好的銷售成績讓她今年獲得加薪。

examples.en: All staff will receive a three percent pay raise in July.
examples.zh: 全體員工將在七月獲得百分之三的加薪。

examples.en: Thank you for approving my pay raise request.
examples.zh: 謝謝您核准我的加薪申請。

similar.diff: 說法較正式，常用在書面文件與公告。

example.en: The salary increase will start on the first of April.
example.zh: 加薪將從四月一日開始。

similar.diff: 美式與英式都能用，語氣中性。

example.en: The union asked for a pay increase for all workers.
example.zh: 工會為全體員工要求加薪。

confusable.diff: bonus 是一次性的獎金，pay raise 是把固定薪資調高。

example.en: She received a bonus for finishing the project early.
example.zh: 她因提早完成專案而拿到一筆獎金。

extra_vocab.en: knowledge you get by doing real work, not only by studying
extra_vocab.note: 此處照原樣保留拼法，正確拼法是 practical experience。多益常見於徵才廣告與履歷，如 requires two years of practical experience。
extra_vocab.pattern: have / gain + practical experience + in + 領域
extra_vocab.grammar_note: experience 指「經驗」時是不可數名詞，不加 s，也不說 an experience；只有指某一次經歷時才可數。

examples.en: This job requires at least two years of practical experience.
examples.zh: 這份工作至少需要兩年的實務經驗。

examples.en: I gained practical experience in sales during my internship.
examples.zh: 我在實習期間累積了業務的實務經驗。

examples.en: Do you have practical experience with customer service?
examples.zh: 你有客戶服務的實務經驗嗎？

examples.en: The course gives students practical experience before graduation.
examples.zh: 這門課讓學生在畢業前累積實務經驗。

example.en: We need someone with hands-on experience in marketing.
example.zh: 我們需要有行銷實戰經驗的人。

similar.diff: 泛指工作經歷，不一定強調實際操作的技能。

example.en: Please list your work experience on the form.
example.zh: 請在表格上列出你的工作經歷。

extra_vocab.en: a document that shows you work for a company
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於申請貸款、簽證、租屋時，要求提供公司開立的證明文件。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: proof 在這裡是不可數名詞，不說 a proof of employment，也不加 s；要指文件可說 a letter as proof of employment。

examples.en: The bank asked me for proof of employment for the loan.
examples.zh: 銀行要求我提供在職證明以辦理貸款。

examples.en: You must show proof of employment when you apply for a visa.
examples.zh: 申請簽證時必須出示在職證明。

examples.en: Please contact HR to get proof of employment today.
examples.zh: 請今天聯絡人資部門取得在職證明。

examples.en: The landlord needs proof of employment from each new tenant.
examples.zh: 房東需要每位新房客提供在職證明。

similar.diff: 更正式，指由公司開立、確認你在職的信件。

example.en: HR sent me an employment verification letter yesterday.
example.zh: 人資昨天寄給我一封在職證明信。

similar.diff: 指正式的在職證明書，常見於申請文件。

example.en: She submitted a certificate of employment with her application.
example.zh: 她在申請時附上了在職證明書。

confusable.diff: proof of purchase 是「購買證明」（如發票、收據），和工作無關。

example.en: Keep your proof of purchase in case you need a refund.
example.zh: 請保留購買證明，以防需要退款。
